sentences.en: He is one of the British hopefuls for the London Olympics.
sentences.zh: 他是参加伦敦奥运会的英国希望之星。

sentences.en: It turns out that we became hopeful in vain.
sentences.zh: 结果证明我们是枉然地抱有希望。

sentences.en: Sami was hopeful that Layla's agitation might be subsiding.
sentences.zh: 萨米认为莱拉的烦躁可能正在减轻。
